sourceFile: 25. TIU C11-20  Report test Plate supplier Yousteel NG difference with standard 100% 2026.02.24_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparative evidence but misgroups test methods as changed conditions and includes weak derived measurement evidence.
issues: Changed factor conflates Test PT with decap and drop test methods.
Supplier/standard factor from title is not clearly represented.
Decap and drop results lack baseline comparison and should be non-comparative outcomes.
Measurement outcome from header/derived row is not valid final evidence.
Key cited rows Test!18 and Test!26 are not shown in context.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Yousteel NG-difference/Test PT plate versus Normal standard 100%.
Keep decap bonding and drop test as outcome/test-method results under the same validation context.
Remove or downgrade the derived measurement outcome unless raw measurement rows are cited.
Cite actual header and result rows for Test!18 and Test!26 or remove them.
Use decision rows Test!39-Test!40 to support final judgement and limitations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are partly sufficient for NG process, but missing/derived rows prevent final evidence approval.
